title: Pulse oximeter Bland–Altman bias and 95% limits of agreement
what: Mean bias +1.65% SpO2 (95% LoA -1.3% to +4.6%), with wider positive bias below 90% SaO2

reader_questions.question: What is the wearable oximeter's mean bias vs arterial SaO2?
reader_questions.expected: About +1.65% SpO2 (95% limits of agreement -1.3% to +4.6%).

reader_questions.question: How is agreement spread quantified?
reader_questions.expected: 95% limits of agreement (±1.96 SD) across n = 60 paired readings.

reader_questions.question: Does error behave uniformly across oxygenation levels?
reader_questions.expected: No — error and overestimation widen noticeably below 90% SaO2.
